title: Implants from Roger Leir's surgeries, one sending a radio signal

tellings.quote: from the surgeries he did. And we found one that was remarkable. when it was in C2 in the person's neck, it was emitting an a radio signal.

plain: In the 1990s, Roger Leir, a doctor who surgically removed small objects from people who said they had been abducted, recovered a set of supposed implants, and one of them, while still sitting at the C2 vertebra in a patient's neck, was sending out a radio signal. The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he took part in studying them, tells this to Michels, also naming a William Malow. If true, the objects were working devices, not just debris.
